title: Durable cache rewrites the whole JSON snapshot on every mutation
evidence: eckythump-go/graph/cache.go:persist() — every PutEntity/PutRelationship/SetWatermark/ClearPending calls persist(), which marshals all entities+relationships and does WriteFile+Rename; O(n) I/O per single-row change
suggestion: Acceptable for the fixture-sized graph and satisfies R6 ('embedded DB or equivalent'), but a real embedded store (or batched/debounced persistence) would scale better under sync load

title: Fixture loader resolves paths via build-time runtime.Caller location
evidence: eckythump-go/internal/fixtures/fixtures.go:Dir() uses runtime.Caller(0) then walks up to find fixtures/version-strings.json
suggestion: Works because retort runs `go test` in the source tree (defect_rate=1.0 confirms); would fail if the compiled test binary ran detached from its source tree. go:embed of the fixtures would make tests location-independent

title: Exclusive-since semantics (R3) are documented but enforced server-side
evidence: eckythump-go/syncengine/sync.go:BuildRequest() sends the persisted server_time verbatim as filters.since; the strictly-greater-than comparison is the server's responsibility (comment at sync.go head notes this)
suggestion: Correct for a client port — the client cannot enforce the server's comparison operator; the watermark is never sourced from the local clock, which is the checkable part of R3

title: Port uses only the Go standard library (zero external dependencies)
evidence: eckythump-go/go.mod declares module eckythump / go 1.26 with no require block; no go.sum
suggestion: Idiomatic and offline-buildable; JSON-RPC stdio transport and the snapshot store are hand-rolled on stdlib. No action needed

title: Graphify tooling produced a graph report and AST cache
evidence: graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md and graphify-out/cache/ast/v0.9.20/* present in the archive; graph_usage_score=1.0 in scores.json
